messages:
Ruth (PM): Quick thread to finalize what we ship for GA: the tenant-level cost widget, trace sampling guarantees, and the operator handoff checklist. Customers asked for predictable billing and an on-call playbook.

Jon (ENG): Engineering constraints: we can emit projected USD/24h, per-feature spend (top 10 features), and a sampling_state flag. We can also support a per-tenant "grace retention" override for 24h to help debugging.

Samir (SRE): Ops requirements: default hard cap $125/day per-tenant for GA. Behavior on cap: 1) downgrade span payloads to headers-only; 2) reduce sample_rate to 0.0005; 3) mark tenant as THROTTLED in Console and trigger PagerDuty to tenant owner. Also need a global emergency kill-switch.

Pri (ML): For launch acceptance we need two measurable signals: (1) recall on priority error clusters >= 92% across 48h canary; (2) no customer-facing anomaly detection F1 regression > 4% versus full-capture baseline. If either fails, enable grace retention for the affected tenant.

Ruth (PM): Console copy: badge labels = normal / uplifted / throttled. Tenant card: "Budget today (USD)", "Projected 24h", "Top costly features". Add one-click actions: "Pause Hi-Fi Traces" and "Request Investigate Retention" (enterprise).

Jon (ENG): API shape (example):

```
{
  "sampling": {"rate": 0.001, "error_preserve_pct": 0.12, "adaptive": [{"when":"error_rate>0.8%","rate":0.01,"ttl":3600}]},
  "budget": {"daily_usd": 125, "preset":"team"},
  "flags": {"grace_retention_until":"2026-04-05T12:00:00Z"}
}
```

Samir (SRE): Operational notes: add runbook step to revert tenant to conservative sampling 0.0002 if more than 4 tenants throttle within 72h. Add a dashboard listing throttled tenants with reason and projected spend.

Pri (ML): Canary plan: pick 3 tenants (one enterprise, one high-throughput mid-market, one internal stress-test). Run recall eval at 24h and 48h, produce a short report of error-cluster coverage and F1 impact. Acceptance requires both signals pass or documented mitigation in place.

Ruth (PM): Handoff checklist for operators (short):
- How to read tenant card and interpret "throttled" status (owner: Ruth)
- How to apply grace retention (owner: Jon)
- How to trigger global kill-switch and rollback sampling (owner: Samir)
- Where to find canary reports and error-cluster mappings (owner: Pri)

Jon (ENG): Timeline: sampling + budget enforcement in 2 sprints, Console card and actions sprint 3, grace-retention fast-path in sprint 2. I'll open PR for API schema today.

Samir (SRE): I'll draft runbook and PagerDuty flow. Need ability to mute tenant alerts for a support window.

HandoffBot: Created ticket: infra/obs-3150 "tenant-cost-widget + sampling handoff" assigned to @Jon.

Ruth (PM): OK. Next sync Thursday 10am to review canary tenants and operator playbook. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
